consent.subtitle: Please read and sign the consent forms before proceeding

content.consent1_body:
I hereby voluntarily consent to obtaining an online thyroid opinion from ThyroConsult. I understand that:

1. This is an online opinion service and does not replace an in-person medical consultation.
2. The opinion provided is based solely on the reports and information I submit.
3. In case of emergency, I should immediately contact a nearby hospital or call emergency services.
4. The doctor may request additional tests or reports if required.
5. The opinion provided is specific to the reports submitted and may change with new reports.
6. I am responsible for the accuracy of the information and reports I submit.
7. ThyroConsult and its doctors shall not be liable for any adverse outcomes resulting from incomplete or inaccurate information provided by me.
content.consent2_body:
ThyroConsult is committed to protecting your privacy and personal health information.

1. DATA COLLECTION: We collect your name, contact details, date of birth, medical reports, and photographs solely for the purpose of providing online thyroid opinion.

2. DATA STORAGE: All your data is stored on secure, encrypted servers. We use AES-256 encryption for data at rest and TLS 1.3 for data in transit.

3. DATA USE: Your data will only be used to provide you with online opinion services. We will never sell, share, or disclose your data to third parties without your explicit consent, except as required by law.

4. DATA RETENTION: Your data will be retained for a period of 7 years as required by Indian medical regulations.

5. YOUR RIGHTS: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.

6. PHOTOGRAPHS: Your photograph is taken solely for identity verification and will not be shared or used for any other purpose.
content.consent3_body:
By registering on ThyroConsult, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

1. ELIGIBILITY: You must be at least 18 years of age to register independently. Persons under 18 may register with a guardian's consent and participation.

2. ACCURACY: You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and at all times thereafter.

3. ONLINE OPINION ONLY: ThyroConsult provides online thyroid opinions. This is not a teleconsultation, telemedicine, or emergency service.

4. FEES: The fee for online opinion is non-refundable once the opinion has been provided. In case of non-delivery, a full refund will be initiated within 7 working days.

5. REPORTS: You are responsible for uploading clear, legible, and authentic reports. ThyroConsult is not responsible for opinions based on fraudulent or tampered reports.

6. CONDUCT: You agree not to misuse this platform, harass doctors or staff, or use the service for any unlawful purpose.

7. GOVERNING LAW: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of courts in [City].
content.consent4_body:
I, the undersigned guardian of the minor patient named in this registration, hereby declare that:

1. I am the legal guardian of the said minor patient.
2. I am providing this consent on behalf of the minor patient who is under 18 years of age.
3. I have read and understood all the consent forms, privacy policy, and terms and conditions on behalf of the minor.
4. I consent to the collection, storage, and processing of the minor's personal and medical data as described in the Privacy & Data Policy.
5. I understand that the online opinion provided is based solely on the reports and information submitted and does not replace an in-person medical consultation.
6. I accept full responsibility for the accuracy of the information and reports submitted on behalf of the minor.
7. I acknowledge that ThyroConsult and its doctors shall not be liable for any adverse outcomes resulting from incomplete or inaccurate information provided by me on behalf of the minor.
